help_output:
usage: __main__.py [-h] --project PROJECT --contract CONTRACT --output OUTPUT
                   [--test-path TEST_PATH] [--pythonpath PYTHONPATH]
                   [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--order ORDER]
                   {init,verify}

A usable local strict pytest verification gate. The approved contract must be
created on a trusted baseline and kept outside candidate write scopes. Private
copying is isolation of files, not an OS sandbox.

positional arguments:
  {init,verify}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --contract CONTRACT
  --output OUTPUT
  --test-path TEST_PATH
  --pythonpath PYTHONPATH
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --order ORDER         JSON exact registry permutation; never a subset
